title: sl-atlas Concept
description: Canonical schema for a single Atlas concept. CONTENT-SCHEMA.md is the human-readable summary; this file is the enforced contract.

id.description: kebab-case identifier; must match the filename and the entry in concepts.js

path.description: Position in the atlas learning path (1 = start here). Unique across published concepts; drives sidebar order, j/k navigation, and the next/previous footer on each concept page.

views.description: All three keys MUST be present. Each view may be null to indicate a draft / Teacher-BLOCKED state; publishable concepts have all three as non-empty strings.

interactive.description: Optional identifier for an interactive demo mounted by app.js (e.g., 'lwe-matrix').

checks.description: Optional self-check questions rendered at the end of the concept (reveal-on-click answers). Formative assessment, not a quiz — answers must teach, not just grade. Reviewed by the Teacher gate like any prose.

items.description: Short ID of an entry registered in CITATIONS.md at the repo root.

citations.description: External works this concept cites at any depth. Every ID must exist in CITATIONS.md — enforced by scripts/check-citations.mjs.

status.description: Free-form publication status note. Used to record BLOCKED state when any view is null. Example: 'BLOCKED — Teacher review 2026-06-09 (missing Simple view)'.

_publication_status_note.description: Optional long-form note about why a draft is not published. The leading underscore marks it as a meta-field.
